column1: # PC 1 kHz whole-arm runtime control template
# units: velocity=rad/s, torque=Nm, ratio=0..1; kp/kd are unscaled MIT gains.
# The Qt "写入 MCU 控制模板" action sends this profile to the MCU and commits
# it to the MCU Flash record (it does not write the motor's own parameter Flash).
# Import/write with the arm disabled; verify targets and support the arm before enabling.
# velocity_limit_rad_s is v_des of position-velocity drives (unused in MIT):
# 3 rad/s for J1..J7 (J3/J4 rated 3.77) so position-velocity Cartesian moves
# are not held at 0.9 rad/s; the J1..J7 application ceiling is 3.14 rad/s.
